applicableAreas: southern boundary landscape, adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: Five mitigation trees are plotted 5-10 feet from the overhead electric line on the southern boundary of the landscape plan. Without cross-referencing specific species from the plant schedule, the utility-compatible (UC) status per ECM Appendix F cannot be verified from the landscape plan alone. Proposed species may include non-utility-compatible varieties.

applicableAreas: southern boundary landscape, adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: Five mitigation trees are plotted 5-10 feet from the overhead electric line, well within the 25-foot clearance zone required for large trees (mature height ≥40 feet per ECM Appendix F). The mature heights of proposed tree species cannot be confirmed from the landscape plan alone; cross-reference to Sheet 35 planting specifications and ECM Appendix F mature height classifications is required.

applicableAreas: entire site, proposed trees throughout landscape plan
findings.comment: Overhead electric utility pole locations are not explicitly marked or dimensioned on the landscape plan (Sheet 31). While the OHE line is shown, individual pole positions must be inferred. Clearances from proposed trees to poles (minimum 10 lateral feet required) cannot be verified without explicit pole location callouts.

Pad-mounted transformer locations shown on Sheet 21 (Electrical Plan) are not cross-referenced or depicted on Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan). Clearances from proposed trees to pad-mount equipment (minimum 10 lateral feet required, or between access door and drivable surface) cannot be verified from landscape plan alone.

Underground electric equipment locations (pull boxes, vaults) shown on Sheet 21 (Electrical Plan) are not depicted on Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan). Clearances from proposed trees to underground equipment (minimum 5 lateral feet required) cannot be verified from landscape plan alone.

Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment require root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment). Without underground equipment locations shown on landscape plan, and without root barrier specifications on the landscape plan details, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: southern boundary landscape, adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: The five mitigation trees proposed adjacent to the overhead electric line on Sheet 31 are identified only by the generic label 'M' (Mitigation Tree) and generic tree symbols (+, x, dot). Common and scientific names for these specific trees are not provided on the landscape plan itself; reviewer must cross-reference to Sheet 35 plant schedule. Provide species identification directly on landscape plan or add a clear legend linking tree symbols to species names for trees near electrical facilities.

applicableAreas: southern boundary landscape, adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: Large trees (mature height ≥40 feet per ECM Appendix F) are not differentiated or called out on the landscape plan. While the planting plan shows various tree symbols, it does not distinguish trees by mature height category, making it impossible to verify at a glance which trees fall within the large-tree clearance zones without consulting external reference materials.

applicableAreas: southern boundary landscape, adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: The landscape plan proposes trees (5 mitigation trees) within 15 feet of overhead electric lines on the southern boundary. Without documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing tree placement in this restricted zone, compliance with clearance variances cannot be verified. Provide either compliance through distance relocation, or explicit written approval from Austin Energy if variation is requested.
